title: Career Roadmap: Robotics Programmer (Junior)
summary: Career Domain: Engineering, Technology & Computing · Qualification Pathway: BCA – BCA - IoT / Robotics · Target Career: Robotics Programmer (Junior)

about.label: About this roadmap
about.text: This roadmap was drafted with AI assistance from OneGrasp's related roadmaps and is awaiting expert review. Check fees, dates, eligibility and exam patterns on the official websites before you rely on them.

blocks.text: A Junior Robotics Programmer writes the software that makes robots and automated machines move, sense and decide, from warehouse robots to factory arms and educational robots.

items.text: Program robot motion, sensors and simple behaviours
Test and debug code on simulators and real robots
Document code and support senior engineers on projects
Build Arduino projects with motors and sensors
Learn ROS 2 basics and a simulator (Gazebo)
Build a line-following or obstacle-avoiding robot

blocks.text: Year 3: Real projects and a job

items.text: Add computer vision with OpenCV to a robot project
Intern with a robotics or automation company
Publish your projects with videos on GitHub

blocks.label: Before you enrol
blocks.text: Check the current syllabus, fees and eligibility on the certifying body's official website.

items.text: MCA / M.Sc in AI or Robotics
PG Diploma in Robotics and Automation

items.text: MS in Robotics / Mechatronics (Germany, US) - may need bridging courses after BCA
